_purpose: Issue #101 Task 35 Step 4: model freeze manifest. Written immediately after the VAL screening gate PASSed and BEFORE any formal-TEST candidate pool generation or evaluation. Everything below is now frozen: no retraining, no best_iteration change, no feature change, no hyperparameter change, no baseline-arm change, no threshold change. The formal TEST result (Step 6) is judged against exactly this artifact, once.

model_artifact.note: best_iteration=199 of n_estimators=200 -- early stopping (patience=20) never triggered; training used every configured tree.

hyperparameters.source: scripts/train_reranker.py::LIGHTGBM_HYPERPARAMETERS / EARLY_STOPPING_ROUNDS, unchanged from the pre-existing protocol audited in Task 35 Step 1

feature_schema.note: max/mean_template_log_frequency (indices 16/17) are post-hoc imputed by train_reranker.py from a TRAIN-frozen frequency table -- see impute_frequency_features's doc -- never written back to the exported pool file.

combined_pool.built_by: scripts/phase3e_build_combined_pool.py, order=train_then_val (pure byte concatenation, no rows added/removed/modified)

combined_split_manifest.note: Concatenation of Phase 3D.5's coverage_{train,val}_full.json.split_manifest_subset.jsonl -- explicit target_id -> split assignment, overriding the default SHA-256 hash bucket (see load_split_manifest); required by train_reranker.py to cover every target_id in --groups exactly once.

primary_baseline.selection_basis: Its own arm description in scripts/train_reranker.py's build_baseline_arms ("a sanity-check baseline: if the reranker can't beat 'trust the upstream order', it isn't adding anything") -- no constant named PRIMARY_BASELINE exists in the codebase; original_rank is the only arm that is always computable under this project's Exhaustive proposal mode (upstream_score and availability are both not_computable -- see Task 35 Step 1's audit).

additional_conditions: coverage_identical=True (structural: both arms scored the identical group set)
top1_hit_rate delta's 95% CI lower bound > 0 (paired bootstrap, resample_unit=target_id, n_resamples=1000, seed=1234)
gate_thresholds.source: scripts/train_reranker.py::GATE_THRESHOLDS, unchanged from the pre-existing protocol audited in Task 35 Step 1

metric_definitions.conditional: denominator = groups with >=1 positive candidate in their own pool ('given ranking is possible at all, how good is it')
metric_definitions.end_to_end: denominator = every labeled group in the split, including groups with zero pool candidates or zero positive candidates ('coverage miss' scores 0, never excluded) -- gate thresholds are checked against END-TO-END deltas
metric_definitions.top1_hit_rate: fraction of groups where the top-ranked candidate is a true positive
metric_definitions.top10_hit_rate: fraction of groups where any of the top-10-ranked candidates is a true positive
metric_definitions.mean_reciprocal_rank: mean of 1/rank(first true positive), 0 for a coverage miss under end_to_end

prohibited_after_this_point: any modification to model.txt, pool_combined.jsonl, groups_combined.jsonl, labels_combined.jsonl, split_manifest_combined.jsonl, or manifest_combined.json in this directory
